name: Product gallery
description: A main image with a thumbnail rail, a zoom affordance and an image counter, where clicking a thumb swaps the main image.

name: Buy box
description: The full right-hand column: eyebrow, title, star rating with a review link, price, short description, add to cart, and a save action.

name: Variant selector
description: Colour swatches and size pills as keyboard operable radio groups, with selected, unavailable and sold out states kept distinct.

name: Quantity stepper
description: Minus and plus either side of a number input, floored at 1 and capped at the order limit, with a disabled state at each bound.

name: Price block
description: Every price presentation in one block: single, sale against RRP with a percent off badge, per unit, from price, and instalments.

name: Stock and urgency
description: The availability cues: in stock, low stock with a count and a bar, sold out with a notify action, and a live viewing count.

name: Delivery estimator
description: A postcode check that returns a delivery window and a shipping cost, with both a result state and an error state.

name: Sticky add to cart bar
description: The bar that slides in once the buy box scrolls away, carrying thumb, title, variant summary, price and an add button.

name: Product accordion
description: Description, specifications, shipping and returns as native details disclosures with an animated chevron marker.

name: Guarantee row
description: A four up row of icon, label and one line of reassurance for shipping, returns, warranty and secure payment.

name: Bundle and save
description: Three products bought together at a combined price, with a checkbox per item that recalculates the total, the saving and the button.

name: Cross sell rail
description: A horizontally scrollable goes well with rail of compact product cards, each carrying a quick add button.

name: Specification table
description: A two column specification table with a size guide link that opens a dialog holding the measurements table.
